verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR as supported on its all-in-one platform. The docs show several frameworks running in one workspace with shared controls: removing a framework keeps any controls another framework still requires. Oneleet also markets one flat price with no per-framework fees, which supports adding a framework without adopting a new tool. Missing for 10: framework-specific documentation for HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS (control libraries, mappings, audit workflow), docs on adding a new framework, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage depth beyond the marketing page.
